decision.explanation: Document D1S3 explicitly states 'Croatia. Runner-up.' in the context of the 2018 World Cup. This directly supports the claim that Croatia was the runner-up. Document D3S3 similarly states 'Netherlands. Runner-up.' but this appears to be a separate entry or error, as it conflicts with the widely accepted historical fact and does not clarify if it refers to a different tournament or category.
